授業概要
The course of water resources and environmental engineering is formed to train students to be involved in the scientific and engineering principles needed to analyze and solve water resources and environmental engineering problems, and experience in the practice of environmental engineering related to water, and wastewater management.
The course will examine key concepts in water pollution, hazardous wastes, water, and environmental standards. This course will aid your understanding of interesting and complex environmental topics. The course is valuable as a bridge to more advanced courses in water and environmental engineering, as a technical education for interested students and as an introduction to water and environmental constraints that are increasingly important to other science and engineering disciplines.
